anchors.meaning: Actual physical damage entry; 0x409bca is padding after the preceding helper, not an entry.
Weapon element at actor+c4: -1 disables the bonus helper.
Weapon element/low/high copy from item+8c/90/94 to actor+c4/c8/cc.
Impact object is constructed with effective critical rate, combined hit chance and queued damage.
Ordinary stamina uses the queued pre-impact damage at 0x4c2ae0, not the later critical value.
Ordinary impact checks the saved hit roll before drawing its critical chance.
Critical callback submits engine event0x302; it is not evidence of a named WAV asset.
Source attack_damagex2 is loaded with cleared default and stored at base+1a0.

limits: Hit, ordinary-damage and weapon-bonus helpers return normally. Critical impact, fallback and refresh are bounded slices before callbacks.
Synthetic positive-domain actor/weapon profiles; no full native initialization, presentation, counters or whole exchange execution.
RNG bounds/order checked, including rand0 and raw fallback; Godot is not asserted to use identical global PRNG state.
